rv.q: This production is the model of sophisticated and frothy escapism at its best.
The result is a production that maintains the original's comedic momentum while arriving at a more earnest and resonant conclusion.
Everything about this touring production is smashing.
“It Hot” is full of razzle-dazzle, romance, and the tender journey of self-discovery, which all adds up to a great time at the theater.
This show is entertainment at its finest leaving a toe-tapping song and a classic story in audiences hearts.
From that point on, Act One motors along jauntily, but Act Two is when “Some Like It Hot” starts to elevate, almost levitate, and turns into something really special.

cn.t: Critics praise this Tony-winning musical as a dazzling, sophisticated spectacle with breathtaking choreography and luxurious production values. The show seamlessly blends old-fashioned glamour with a modern, timely message about identity and acceptance.
